1.t: Alif Lam Ra These are the verses of the Scripture, a Quran that makes things clear.

2.t: The disbelievers may well come to wish they had submitted to God,

3.t: so [Prophet] leave them to eat and enjoy themselves. Let [false] hopes distract them: they will come to know.

4.t: Never have We destroyed a community that did not have a set time;

5.t: no community can bring its time forward, nor delay it.

6.t: They say, ‘Receiver of this Quran! You are definitely mad.

7.t: Why do you not bring us the angels, if you are telling the truth?’

8.t: But We send down the angels only to bring justice and then these people will not be reprieved.

9.t: We have sent down the Quran Ourself, and We Ourself will guard it. Even before you [Prophet],

10.t: We sent messengers among the various communities of old,

11.t: but they mocked every single messenger that came to them:

12.t: in this way We make the message slip through the hearts of evildoers.

13.t: They will not believe in it. That was what happened with the peoples of long ago,

14.t: and even if We opened a gateway into Heaven for them and they rose through it, higher and higher,

15.t: they would still say, ‘Our eyes are hallucinating. We are bewitched.’

16.t: We have set constellations up in the sky and made it beautiful for all to see,

17.t: and guarded it from every stoned satan:

18.t: any eavesdropper will be pursued by a clearly visible flame.

19.t: As for the earth, We have spread it out, set firm mountains on it, and made everything grow there in due balance.

20.t: We have provided sustenance in it for you and for all those creatures for whom you do not provide.

21.t: There is not a thing whose storehouses are not with Us. We send it down only according to a well-defined measure:

22.t: We send the winds to fertilize, and We bring down water from the sky for you to drink- you do not control its sources.

23.t: It is We who give life and death; it is We who inherit [everything].

24.t: We know exactly those of you who come first and those who come later.

25.t: [Prophet], it is your Lord who will gather them all together: He is all wise, all knowing.

26.t: We created man out of dried clay formed from dark mud-

27.t: the jinn We created before, from the fire of scorching wind.

28.t: Your Lord said to the angels, ‘I will create a mortal out of dried clay, formed from dark mud.

29.t: When I have fashioned him and breathed My spirit into him, bow down before him,’

30.t: and the angels all did so.

31.t: But not Iblis: he refused to bow down like the others.

32.t: God said, ‘Iblis, why did you not bow down like the others?’

33.t: and he answered, ‘I will not bow to a mortal You created from dried clay, formed from dark mud.’

34.t: ‘Get out of here!’ said God. ‘You are an outcast,

35.t: rejected until the Day of Judgement.’

36.t: Iblis said, ‘My Lord, give me respite until the Day when they are raised from the dead.’

38.t: ‘until the Day of the Appointed Time.’

39.t: Iblis then said to God, ‘Because You have put me in the wrong, I will lure mankind on earth and put them in the wrong,

41.t: God said, ‘[Devotion] is a straight path to Me:

42.t: you will have no power over My servants, only over the ones who go astray and follow you.

43.t: Hell is the promised place for all these,

44.t: with seven gates, each gate having its allotted share of them.

45.t: But the righteous will be in Gardens with springs-

47.t: and We shall remove any bitterness from their hearts: [they will be like] brothers, sitting on couches, face to face.

48.t: No weariness will ever touch them there, nor will they ever be expelled.’

49.t: [Prophet], tell My servants that I am the Forgiving, the Merciful,

50.t: but My torment is the truly painful one.

51.t: Tell them too about Abraham’s guests:

52.t: when they came to him and said, ‘Peace,’ he said, ‘We are afraid of you.’

53.t: ‘Do not be afraid,’ they said, ‘We bring you good news of a son who will have great knowledge.’

54.t: He said, ‘How can you give me such news when old age has come to me? What sort of news is this?’

55.t: They said, ‘We have told you the truth, so do not despair.’

56.t: He said, ‘Who but the misguided despair of the mercy of their Lord?’

57.t: and then asked, ‘Messengers, what is your errand?’

58.t: They replied, ‘We have been sent to a people who are guilty.’

59.t: But We shall save the household of Lot,

60.t: all except his wife: We have decreed that she will be one of those who stay behind.

61.t: When the messengers came to the household of Lot,

63.t: They said, ‘We have brought you what they said would never happen:

64.t: we have brought you the Truth. We speak truly,

65.t: so leave in the dead of the night with your household, and walk behind them. Let none of you look back. Go where you are commanded.’

66.t: We made this decree known to him: the last remnants of those people would be wiped out in the morning.

67.t: The people of the town came along, revelling,

68.t: and he told them, ‘These are my guests, do not disgrace me.

69.t: Fear God, and do not shame me.’

70.t: They answered, ‘Have we not told you not to interfere [between us and] anyone else?’

71.t: He said, ‘My daughters are here, if you must.’

72.t: By your life [Prophet], they wandered on in their wild intoxication

73.t: and the blast overtook them at sunrise:

74.t: We turned their city upside down and rained on them a shower of clay stones.

75.t: There truly is a sign in this for those who can learn-

76.t: it is still there on the highway-

77.t: there truly is a sign in this for those who believe.

79.t: and We took retribution on them; both are still there on the highway, plain for all to see.

80.t: The people of al-Hijr also rejected Our messengers:

81.t: We gave them Our signs, but they turned their backs.

82.t: They carved out dwellings in the mountains, and lived in security-

83.t: the blast overwhelmed them early in the morning.

84.t: What they had gained was of no use to them.

85.t: We did not create the heavens and the earth and everything between them without a true purpose: the Hour will certainly come, so [Prophet] bear with them graciously.

86.t: Your Lord is the All Knowing Creator.

87.t: We have given you the seven oft-recited versesand the whole glorious Quran.

88.t: Do not look longingly at the good things We have given some to enjoy. Do not grieve over the [disbelievers], but lower your wings over the believers

89.t: and say, ‘I am here to give plain warning,’

90.t: like the [warning] We have sent down for those who divide themselves into bands

92.t: by your Lord, We will question them all

94.t: So proclaim openly what you have been commanded [to say], and ignore the idolaters.

95.t: We are enough for you against all those who ridicule your message,

96.t: who set up another god beside God- they will come to know.

97.t: We are well aware that your heart is weighed down by what they say.

98.t: Celebrate the glory of your Lord and be among those who bow down to Him:

99.t: worship your Lord until what is certain comes to you.
